cards.scene_sentence: Let it go.
cards.everyday_example: It was an honest mistake, so let it go.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 那是个无心之失，别再纠结了。

cards.scene_sentence: It's not a big deal.
cards.everyday_example: Changing the time is not a big deal.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 改一下时间不是什么大事。

cards.definition_zh: 需要技巧的动作或操作
cards.scene_sentence: You reach in, there's one maneuver and bam!
cards.scene_translation_zh: 手伸进去，做一个动作，砰！
cards.everyday_example: Parking here requires a tricky maneuver.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 在这里停车需要一个有难度的操作。

cards.scene_sentence: Right out the sleeve.
cards.everyday_example: The answer came right out of the manual.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 答案直接来自手册。

cards.scene_sentence: Guys don't do anything that comes close.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 男人做的事没有任何一件能比得上。
cards.everyday_example: Nothing else comes close to this view.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 其他景色都无法与这里相比。

cards.scene_sentence: Know what blows my mind?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你知道什么让我很震惊吗？
cards.everyday_example: The scale of the universe blows my mind.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 宇宙的尺度让我震撼。

cards.scene_sentence: How you get any work done is beyond me.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我真不明白你怎么还能完成工作。
cards.everyday_example: Why they canceled the project is beyond me.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我完全不明白他们为什么取消项目。

cards.scene_sentence: Not a one!
cards.everyday_example: I asked for volunteers, but not a one replied.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我征集志愿者，但一个回复的也没有。

cards.definition_zh: 下地狱吧，用于表达强烈愤怒
cards.scene_sentence: May he rot in hell.
cards.everyday_example: The phrase 'rot in hell' is extremely hostile.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: “下地狱吧”是非常敌意的表达。

cards.scene_sentence: You finally get up the courage to do it.
cards.everyday_example: I got up the courage to ask for a raise.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我鼓起勇气要求加薪。

cards.scene_sentence: She'd feel like we're ganging up on her.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 她会觉得我们在联合针对她。
cards.everyday_example: Don't all gang up on him at once.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 别一下子全都针对他。

cards.scene_sentence: I don't know if it's me or his hunger strike.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我不知道是我的问题，还是因为他在绝食。
cards.everyday_example: The prisoners began a hunger strike.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 囚犯们开始了绝食抗议。

cards.scene_sentence: That guy, he burns me up.
cards.everyday_example: His smug attitude really burns me up.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他自鸣得意的态度真让我火大。

cards.scene_sentence: You're not up to this.
cards.everyday_example: I'm not up to a long hike today.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我今天没体力进行长途徒步。

cards.scene_sentence: You'll never make it on your own.
cards.everyday_example: She moved abroad and made it on her own.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她搬到国外，靠自己站稳了脚跟。

cards.definition_zh: 适合某人，使某人状态变好
cards.scene_sentence: Being dumped by you agrees with her.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 被你甩掉反而让她状态更好了。
cards.everyday_example: The warmer climate really agrees with him.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 更温暖的气候很适合他。

cards.scene_sentence: I don't wanna seem too eager.
cards.everyday_example: Wait a day so you don't seem too eager.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 等一天，免得显得太急切。

cards.scene_sentence: You wanna hear a freakish coincidence?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你想听一个离奇的巧合吗？
cards.everyday_example: Meeting there was a freakish coincidence.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 在那里碰见真是个离奇的巧合。

cards.scene_sentence: Apparently, they're attracted to dryer sheets.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 显然，它们会被烘干纸吸引。
cards.everyday_example: Some insects are attracted to light.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 有些昆虫会被光吸引。

cards.definition_zh: 成熟老练的；复杂精致的
cards.scene_sentence: He's smart, sophisticated, and he has a real job.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 他聪明、成熟，而且有份正经工作。
cards.everyday_example: The app uses a sophisticated search system.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这个应用采用复杂的搜索系统。

cards.scene_sentence: She's like one of a kind, like a snowflake.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 她独一无二，就像雪花一样。
cards.everyday_example: This handmade chair is one of a kind.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这把手工椅是独一无二的。

cards.scene_sentence: Look, I made a huge mistake.
cards.everyday_example: We made a huge mistake by skipping the backup.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们跳过备份，犯了一个大错。

cards.definition_zh: 回到某人身边或回到话题
cards.scene_sentence: Maybe Angela will come back to me.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 也许安吉拉会回到我身边。
cards.everyday_example: Let's come back to this question tomorrow.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们明天再回到这个问题。

cards.scene_sentence: Hold on a sec.
cards.everyday_example: Hold on a sec; I need to save this file.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 等一下，我得先保存这个文件。

cards.scene_sentence: You've thought this through?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你已经把这事想清楚了吗？
cards.everyday_example: We need to think the migration through carefully.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们需要仔细想清楚迁移方案。

cards.scene_sentence: Saturday night, all rules apply.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 周六晚上，所有约会规则都适用。
cards.everyday_example: The same rules apply to remote employees.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 同样的规则也适用于远程员工。

cards.scene_sentence: You may wanna rethink the dirty underwear.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你也许该重新考虑那条脏内裤。
cards.everyday_example: We should rethink the launch date.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们应该重新考虑发布日期。

cards.definition_zh: 但愿别出事；表达无奈或担忧
cards.scene_sentence: God help us.
cards.everyday_example: If he leads the project, God help us.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 如果他来领导项目，那我们只能自求多福了。

cards.scene_sentence: We got the proofs from the shoot with the vegetables.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我们拿到了蔬菜主题拍摄的样片。
cards.everyday_example: Please review the proofs before printing.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 印刷前请检查校样。

cards.scene_sentence: I had the most supremely awful day.
cards.everyday_example: The service was supremely awful tonight.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 今晚的服务糟糕透顶。

cards.scene_sentence: I blew off the afternoon.
cards.everyday_example: He blew off the meeting without warning.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他没打招呼就没参加会议。

cards.scene_sentence: She really cares about you.
cards.everyday_example: Good managers care about their teams.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 好的管理者关心自己的团队。

cards.scene_sentence: The hug looked pretty brutal.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 那个拥抱看起来挺惨烈的。
cards.everyday_example: That workout looks brutal.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 那套训练看起来很残酷。

cards.definition_zh: 穿过；在需要时兑现承诺
cards.scene_sentence: Coming through.
cards.everyday_example: The supplier came through at the last minute.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 供应商在最后关头按约交货了。

cards.scene_sentence: But I saved it.
cards.everyday_example: Can you save me a seat near the front?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你能帮我在前排占个座吗？

cards.scene_sentence: I don't see suds!
cards.everyday_example: Use less detergent if there are too many suds.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 泡沫太多时少放点洗衣液。

cards.definition_zh: 热闹结束了，没什么可看了
cards.scene_sentence: Show's over.
cards.everyday_example: Show's over, everyone; please move along.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 没热闹可看了，大家请散开。

cards.definition_zh: 把不满意的食物或商品退回
cards.scene_sentence: I can't even send back soup.
cards.everyday_example: She sent the cold meal back.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她把冷掉的餐点退了回去。

cards.scene_sentence: It's extra tough!
cards.everyday_example: These bags are extra tough and reusable.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这些袋子特别耐用，可以重复使用。

cards.definition_zh: 手忙脚乱的人；带冒犯性的旧俚语
cards.scene_sentence: Am I being a total laundry spaz?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我是不是个彻底不会洗衣服的笨蛋？
cards.everyday_example: Avoid 'spaz'; say 'I'm all over the place' instead.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 避免使用“spaz”，可以改说“我手忙脚乱”。

cards.scene_sentence: I'll use the gentle cycle.
cards.everyday_example: Wash this sweater on the gentle cycle.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这件毛衣要用轻柔模式洗。

cards.definition_zh: 需要依靠个人判断的决定
cards.scene_sentence: That would be a judgment call.
cards.everyday_example: Whether to delay the launch is a judgment call.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 是否推迟发布需要自行权衡。

cards.scene_sentence: You caught me.
cards.everyday_example: You caught me; I haven't read the report yet.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 被你说中了，我还没读报告。

cards.scene_sentence: Where did you grow up?
cards.everyday_example: I grew up in a small coastal town.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我在一个沿海小镇长大。

cards.scene_sentence: But it's not gonna last.
cards.everyday_example: This cheap cable isn't going to last.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这根廉价线缆用不久。

cards.definition_zh: 像撕创可贴一样迅速完成痛苦的事
cards.scene_sentence: It's like pulling off a Band-Aid.
cards.everyday_example: Resigning felt like pulling off a Band-Aid.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 辞职就像迅速撕掉创可贴。

cards.definition_zh: 害怕建立长期关系或承担责任
cards.scene_sentence: It's about your fear of commitment.
cards.everyday_example: They discussed his fear of commitment openly.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他们坦率讨论了他对承诺的恐惧。

cards.scene_sentence: If we put our heads together, between the two of us we can break them up.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 如果我们一起想办法，我们俩就能拆散他们。
cards.everyday_example: Let's put our heads together and solve this.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们一起动脑解决这件事吧。

cards.definition_zh: 想象中让自己平静的地方
cards.scene_sentence: Go to your happy place.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 去想象一个让你平静的地方。
cards.everyday_example: I picture the beach as my happy place.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我把海滩想象成让我平静的地方。

cards.scene_sentence: Quit making up rules!
cards.everyday_example: You can't make up rules whenever you lose.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你不能每次输了就临时编规则。
